{{for|the son of [[Meri do Ahlan a'Conlin]]|Sedrin a'Conlin}}
'''Sedrin''' was a tight-rope walker in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==History==
After the show was banned from [[Sienda]], Sedrin tried to perform under the influence of alcohol. He fell off of the high rope and died.{{ref/book|5|17}}
